scope.purpose: Bounded mechanics and Limit Burst refresh for unresolved fields on existing PQ-linked Super Soul records.

evidence.use: Current catalogue corroborates characters, triggers, magnitudes, Limit Bursts, and acquisition identities.
Character documentation corroborates Super Soul 060's corrected +20% Ki Blast Skills wording and Limit Burst.
Character documentation corroborates Super Soul 061's Just Guard trigger, +5% Strike/+10% Ki Blast stacking, five-stack cap, and Limit Burst.
Independent player report corroborates Super Soul 055's use as a battle-start full-Ki/Ki-recovery soul and its Limit Burst workflow.
Repository research seed provides independent acquisition/effect provenance for Super Soul 055.

limits: Super Soul 049 duration and stacking remain null because its effect is always active.
Super Soul 055's 30-second Ki Auto-Recovery duration is retained from the maintained catalogue; no stacking behavior was inferred.
Super Soul 060 preserves the documented wording discrepancy between Charged Ki Blasts and Ki Blast Skills; the canonical effect uses the corrected Ki Blast Skills interpretation.
Super Soul 061 has no separately documented duration; its five-stack cap is preserved without inventing a timer.
